_schema: posts_by_team[team] is the authoritative ranked post list: share is that post cluster's fraction of all seconds the team spent standing still (dwellspan/dwellwin) within defradius of its own flag stand while that flag was home. posts[] is the same data flattened with a team tag, so its shares sum to ~2. seeds[] lists every rune seed folded into the cluster. response.* is measured over the window seconds after each "stole" print.
